\"DB가 MOUNT에서 멈췄어요\"는 무슨 뜻일까?: What does "the DB stopped at MOUNT" mean?
아침 점검 중에 선배가 말합니다. \"어젯밤 재기동 때 MOUNT까지만: During the morning check a senior colleague says, "Last night's restart only got as far as MOUNT and stopped." The first time you hear it, a database being half up sounds odd.
오라클에서 <code>STARTUP</code>은 한 번에 켜지는 스위치: In Oracle, STARTUP is not a single switch but a process that goes through three stages in turn (NOMOUNT, MOUNT, OPEN). Each stage opens something different, and a failure stops at that stage. To see the difference, first separate the "instance" from the "database".
어느 단계에서 멈췄는지만 알아도 원인 후보가 크게 줄어듭니다. NOMOU: Just knowing the stage where it stopped narrows the possible causes a lot. Stuck at NOMOUNT: look at the control files first. Stuck at MOUNT: look at the data files or redo logs first.
인스턴스는 메모리, 데이터베이스는 파일: The instance is memory, the database is files
Concepts 문서는 <span class=\"term\">인스턴스</: The Concepts guide defines an instance as "a set of memory structures that manage database files". When an instance starts, it allocates shared memory called the SGA and starts background processes.
좁은 뜻의 <span class=\"term\">데이터베이스</span>: In the narrowest sense, a database is "a set of files on disk": control files, data files and online redo logs. The guide notes that an instance can exist without a database, and a database without an instance.
한 인스턴스는 한 번에 한 DB만 엽니다. RAC에서는 반대로 여러 인스: An instance is associated with only one database at a time. In RAC it is the other way round: several instances open one database together. That is the shape of RAC in stage 11 of the DBA labs.
+ 데이터베이스 = 컨트롤 파일 · 데이터 파일 · 리두 로그: + Database = control files · data files · redo logs
인스턴스는 자기 크기와 설정을 <span class=\"term\">초기: The instance reads its size and settings from the initialization parameter file. According to the Administrator's Guide, when STARTUP is given no PFILE it looks for spfileORCL.ora → spfile.ora → initORCL.ora, in that order. The first two are binary SPFILEs; the last is a text PFILE.
리눅스에서 이 파일들은 Oracle home의 <code>dbs</cod: On Linux these files live in the dbs directory of the Oracle home. The file names contain the SID (ORCL), so a wrong SID makes it look for the wrong file.
셋 다 없으면 인스턴스가 뜨지 못합니다. <code>ORACLE_SID<: If none of the three exists, the instance cannot start. The same happens when the ORACLE_SID environment variable is empty or has the wrong case. This connects to the "Shell and PATH" scene of the Linux anatomy.
NOMOUNT: 메모리를 잡고 프로세스를 띄운다: NOMOUNT: allocate memory and start processes
Concepts 문서가 적은 인스턴스 시작 순서는 이렇습니다. 파라미터: The Concepts guide lists the instance startup steps: find and read the parameter file, allocate the SGA from its values, start the background processes, then open the alert log and trace files and write the explicit parameter settings to the alert log.
여기까지가 <code>NOMOUNT</code>입니다. 아직 어떤 DB: That is NOMOUNT. No database file is open yet, so the instance does not even know the database name. V$INSTANCE shows STARTED, and querying V$DATABASE, which comes from the control file, gives ORA-01507 (database not mounted).
문서에 따르면 NOMOUNT에서 멈추는 일은 보통 DB를 새로 만들거나: According to the guide, you normally stop at NOMOUNT only to create a database or re-create control files. If an ordinary restart stays at NOMOUNT, the next stage failed.
+ alert log에 시작 기록: + startup written to the alert log
MOUNT 단계에서 인스턴스는 <code>CONTROL_FILES</co: At MOUNT the instance opens the control files named in the CONTROL_FILES parameter. The control file is the map of the database: according to the guide, the instance reads it to find the names of the data files and online redo logs.
dbserver02의 ORCL은 컨트롤 파일 사본 두 개를 서로 다른 디: ORCL on dbserver02 keeps two control file copies on different disks. A mounted database is still closed and only DBAs can use it. Querying a business table gives ORA-01219; only V$ views that come from memory and the control file work.
아카이브 모드로 바꾸기, 데이터 파일 복구 같은 작업은 이 단계에서 합니: Work such as switching to archive mode or recovering data files is done at this stage. That is why you often hear "bring it up to MOUNT and then work on it".
~ 데이터 파일 · 리두 로그 위치를 앎: ~ knows where the data files and redo logs are
OPEN: 데이터 파일과 리두 로그를 연다: OPEN: open the data files and redo logs
OPEN 단계에서 문서가 적은 일은 세 가지입니다. Undo가 아닌 테이: The guide lists three things at OPEN: open the online data files of tablespaces other than undo, acquire an undo tablespace, and open the online redo logs. Authorized users can now reach the data.
평소에는 이 세 단계를 따로 치지 않습니다. 인수 없는 <code>sta: Normally you do not type the three stages separately. A plain startup goes through NOMOUNT, MOUNT and OPEN and prints one line per stage.
이미 떠 있는 DB에 다시 <code>startup</code>을 치면: Typing startup on a database that is already up gives ORA-01081: cannot start already-running ORACLE - shut it down first. Make a habit of checking the current stage first with select status from v$instance;.
전원이 꺼졌다면, 열 때 자동으로 복구한다: If the power went out, it recovers automatically on open
정상 종료는 SGA의 내용을 데이터 파일과 리두 로그에 쓰고 파일을 닫습: A normal shutdown writes the SGA contents to the data files and redo logs and closes the files. A power failure or SHUTDOWN ABORT skips this. Changes that were only in memory are lost, and the data files are left inconsistent.
Concepts 문서에 따르면 이렇게 비정상으로 내려간 DB를 다시 열: According to the Concepts guide, instance recovery happens automatically when a database that went down this way is opened again. Changes in the online redo log are reapplied to the data files (rolling forward), and uncommitted changes are rolled back. The SMON background process does this.
복구에 쓰는 것은 온라인 리두 로그와 현재 데이터 파일뿐입니다. 백업은: Recovery uses only the online redo logs and the current data files; no backup is needed. That is why you must never lose the redo logs. Scene 8, "Power cut", of ‘The Journey of a COMMIT’ tells the same story from the commit side.
~ OPEN 중 롤 포워드 (온라인 리두 → 데이터 파일): ~ roll forward during OPEN (online redo → data files)
사례: 컨트롤 파일 하나가 사라졌다: Case: one control file is gone
디스크 정리 중에 누군가 <code>control02.ctl</code>: During a disk cleanup someone deleted control02.ctl. On restart, ORACLE instance started. and the SGA lines appear, then error ORA-00205: the control file could not be identified, so check the alert log.
인스턴스는 떴으니 NOMOUNT까지는 성공했고, MOUNT에서 컨트롤 파: The instance started, so NOMOUNT succeeded; MOUNT failed to open a control file. Missing even one copy makes MOUNT fail. The alert log says which file could not be opened.
남은 사본이 멀쩡하면 DB를 내리고 그 사본을 복사해 빠진 자리를 채운: If the remaining copy is intact, shut down, copy it over the missing one and start again (Managing Control Files). If all copies are lost, restore with RMAN. You try both in the DBA labs, stage 5 (one copy) and stage 6 (all copies lost).
사례: 데이터 파일 하나가 사라졌다: Case: one data file is gone
이번에는 <code>Database mounted.</code>까지 나온: This time you get as far as Database mounted., then ORA-01157 (cannot identify/lock data file 1) and ORA-01110. The control files were read, so MOUNT succeeded; OPEN could not open data file 1.
이것이 선배가 말한 \"MOUNT에서 멈췄다\"입니다. 컨트롤 파일이 알: This is what the senior colleague meant by "it stopped at MOUNT". The file is not where the control file says it is, and the ORA-01110 line names exactly which file.
데이터 파일은 리눅스 <code>rm</code>으로 지우면 휴지통이 없: A data file deleted with Linux rm has no recycle bin. RESTORE just that file from backup, RECOVER it, then open. In stage 5 of the DBA labs you bring back an ordinary data file and a SYSTEM data file.
정리: 내릴 때는 거꾸로 닫는다: Recap: shutting down closes in reverse
올릴 때는 파라미터 파일 → 인스턴스(NOMOUNT) → 컨트롤 파일(M: Starting up went parameter file → instance (NOMOUNT) → control files (MOUNT) → data files and redo logs (OPEN). Shutting down goes in reverse, as in the guide's table: close the database (Database closed), release the control files (Database dismounted), and shut down the instance (ORACLE instance shut down).
종료 방식은 넷입니다. NORMAL(기본값)은 사용자가 모두 나갈 때까지: There are four shutdown modes. NORMAL (the default) waits for all users to disconnect, TRANSACTIONAL waits for running transactions to finish, and IMMEDIATE rolls back transactions and shuts down. Only ABORT stops at once without a checkpoint, so the next startup needs instance recovery.
장애 전화를 받으면 먼저 \"어디까지 올라왔나\"를 확인하세요. <cod: When you get an incident call, first check "how far did it come up". STARTED points to control files, MOUNTED to data files and redo logs, and the alert log says why.
